title: Schedule of Companion Charges — Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
The holder's companion charges under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes are built on the product figures below: the companion base fare per trip, the Hawaii surcharge, whether the holder pays the companion's government taxes and fees, and the phone booking fee for a trip booked through the reservations call center.

| Product | Companion base fare per trip, before taxes (USD) | Hawaii surcharge per trip when Hawaii is eligible (USD) | Companion's taxes and fees paid by the holder | Phone booking fee per trip booked through the reservations call center (USD) | Companion fare and taxes payable with a Crestline credit whose own rules allow it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin | 99 | 0 | yes | 25 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | 119 | 0 | yes | 25 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | 249 | 100 | yes | 0 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | 399 | 100 | yes | 0 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual | 0 | 0 | yes | 0 | yes |
| Crestline Companion Pass Annual | 0 | 0 | yes | 0 | yes |

## Terms used in this schedule

- **Companion base fare** — the fare per companion trip, before taxes, published for the product: 99 USD for the Main Cabin certificate, 119 USD for Main Plus, 249 USD for Premium Economy, 399 USD for First, and 0 USD for both passes.
- **Hawaii surcharge** — an additional companion fare per trip for travel to or from Hawaii, on the products for which Hawaii is eligible: 100 USD on the Premium Economy and First certificates; the Pass Annual is Hawaii-eligible with a surcharge of 0 USD.
- **Phone booking fee** — the fee per companion trip booked through the reservations call center: 25 USD on the Main Cabin and Main Plus certificates and 0 USD on every other product.
- **Taxes and fees** — on every product the holder pays the companion's government taxes and fees.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus trip booked through the reservations call center, with no Hawaii travel, shows a companion base fare of 119 USD and a phone booking fee of 25 USD in this schedule; the same trip on a Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual shows 0 USD for both.
